name: RadioGroup
summary: Exactly one of a few visible options, chosen as part of a form saved by another action: vertical or inline, with option descriptions, unavailable options, a related question revealed under the chosen option, and a tile appearance. Not for a setting that applies at once (a Switch, or a SegmentedControl for 2-5 views), several choices (CheckboxGroup), or more than six options (Select).
a11y: A `fieldset` named by its `legend` (via Field) holding native radios that share one name, so the group is one Tab stop and the arrow keys move and choose, as the APG radio group pattern says. Each option is its own `label` target; descriptions are linked with `aria-describedby`; a group error sets `aria-invalid` on each radio. The chosen dot and its filled ring carry the state, not colour alone; forced colours keep both.

keys.action: into the group (the chosen option, or the first); Arrow keys: move to and choose the next or previous option

props.name: label
props.description: The question, as a question or noun phrase with no colon: "How should we contact you?"

props.name: options
props.description: The options, 2 to 6; more belong in a Select, too many to scroll in a Combobox.

props.name: value
props.description: The chosen value; `null` until the person chooses (no option is chosen for them unless there is a safe default).

props.name: onChange
props.description: The new value. Nothing is saved by choosing alone.

props.name: hint
props.description: One short sentence about the question.

props.name: error
props.description: What is wrong and how to fix it: "Choose how we should contact you".

props.name: necessity
props.description: Marks the question "(optional)"; questions are required by default.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` (default) one per row; `inline` side by side, for two or three short options (Yes, No).

props.name: appearance
props.description: `default`: a circle and words. `tile`: each option a card with its outline, for a few rich choices (a plan, a delivery speed).

props.name: size
props.description: s (16 px circle, 36 px row) for dense filters; normal (20, 44); l (24, 48) for touch-first forms.

props.name: heading
props.description: The question is the page's heading (one question per page).

props.name: disabled
props.description: No option can change. Prefer saying why in the hint.

props.name: label
props.description: The option in a few words, sentence case.

props.name: description
props.description: One short line under the label: what choosing it means or includes.

props.name: meta
props.description: A tile's trailing fact, such as a price or a delivery date.

props.name: disabled
props.description: It can't be chosen now; say why in its description.

props.name: reveals
props.description: One related question shown under this option while it's chosen ("Phone number" under "Phone"). Questions only.
